1.web: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars says these things: “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.
1.asv: And to the angel of the church in Sardis write: These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars: I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and thou art dead.

2.web: Wake up, and keep the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.
2.asv: Be thou watchful, and establish the things that remain, which were ready to die: for I have found no works of thine perfected before my God.

3.web: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it, and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.
3.asv: Remember therefore how thou hast received and didst hear; and keep it, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.

4.web: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that did not defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.
4.asv: But thou hast a few names in Sardis that did not defile their garments: and they shall walk with me in white; for they are worthy.

5.web: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
5.asv: He that overcometh shall thus be arrayed in white garments; and I will in no wise blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

6.web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
6.asv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.

7.web: “To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: “He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:
7.asv: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth and none shall shut, and that shutteth and none openeth:

8.web: “I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.
8.asv: I know thy works (behold, I have set before thee a door opened, which none can shut), that thou hast a little power, and didst keep my word, and didst not deny my name.

9.web: Behold, I give of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie. Behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.
9.asv: Behold, I give of the synagogue of Satan, of them that say they are Jews, and they are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.

10.web: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing, which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
10.asv: Because thou didst keep the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of trial, that hour which is to come upon the whole world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.

11.web: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.
11.asv: I come quickly: hold fast that which thou hast, that no one take thy crown.

12.web: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.
12.asv: He that overcometh, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go out thence no more: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God, and mine own new name.

13.web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
13.asv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.

14.web: “To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Head of God’s creation, says these things:
14.asv: And to the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God:

15.web: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.
15.asv: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.

16.web: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.
16.asv: So because thou art lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will spew thee out of my mouth.

17.web: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing;’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;
17.asv: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art the wretched one and miserable and poor and blind and naked:

18.web: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.
18.asv: I counsel thee to buy of me gold refined by fire, that thou mayest become rich; and white garments, that thou mayest clothe thyself, and that the shame of thy nakedness be not made manifest; and eyesalve to anoint thine eyes, that thou mayest see.

19.web: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.
19.asv: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.

20.web: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and will dine with him, and he with me.
20.asv: Behold, I stand at the door and knock: if any man hear my voice and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

21.web: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame, and sat down with my Father on his throne.
21.asv: He that overcometh, I will give to him to sit down with me in my throne, as I also overcame, and sat down with my Father in his throne.

22.web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”
22.asv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches.
